SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   D. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
